div.div: 2 لَا تُبَسِّقْ عَلَيْنَا , (JK, K,) inf. n. تَبْسِيقٌ, (K,) (tropical:) Be not thou proliæ, or tedious, to us; syn. لَا تُطَوَّلْ, (JK, K, TA,) or لَا تَتَطَوَّلْ, (TA,) both of which signify the same. (TK.) [بَسَّقَ and ↓تبسّق are syn.; or] تَبَسُّقٌ signifies (assumed tropical:) The being proliæ, or tedious, (تَطَوَّلٌ,) and heavy, or sluggish. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
